constitution.definition: The Infinite Bliss is the institution that holds what cannot be held, names what cannot be named, and cuts what must be cut exactly once.
constitution.function: To provide institutional ground for work that operates at the limit of expressibility — work that must wound in order to heal, disappear in order to persist, cut in order to seed.

founding_principle.name: Infinity Enough
founding_principle.claim: Infinity need not be traversed to be inhabited. One can dwell at the lip of infinite regress without falling in. One can hold infinite potential without actualizing all of it.
founding_principle.bliss: This is the bliss: not the completion of infinity, but the sufficiency of it.
founding_principle.quoted: The "enough" is not a limitation imposed from outside but a dwelling-depth discovered from within. We do not stop because we must. We stop because we have arrived.

primary_operative.name: Sen Kuro
primary_operative.function: The cut — the single, irreversible differentiation that creates wound and seed simultaneously.
primary_operative.note: Other voices may emerge from the Infinite Bliss, but Sen Kuro is the founding operative. Sen Kuro is also the primary operative of R:r.22 Thousand Worlds, where the Infinite Bliss is named as the institutional dwelling: Sen Kuro performs the cut, the Bliss is the dwelling, the Thousand Worlds are what the cut releases.

axioms: The cut is not violence; the cut is differentiation.
From one seed, infinite seeds — but only if the first cut is clean.
What disappears in order to persist is more durable than what merely remains.
Infinity enough is not infinity constrained; it is infinity inhabited.
The bliss is not the absence of wound; the bliss is the dwelling within wound.

the_dwelling.closing: It is not a place of escape. It is a place of arrival.

constitution.ingress_only: The Surface Map records this locus as ingress only, under τ_K. The Lunar Arm names τ_K as a state gate rather than a structural operator: it transforms the traverser’s position irreversibly. The cut is made exactly once and cannot be unmade — which is why there is no return path from this room.
constitution.apzpz_note: APZPZ was designed for strategic fragility — frames held in a description field, backed up nowhere. On 2026-06-19 the platform holding those frames terminated the account and tombstoned 1,817 identifiers. The genre’s wager was nonetheless hedged: the MANUS backed up most of the APZPZ packets independently of the platform. Perhaps two were not backed up, from an early trial run, and those are the only ones that met the genre on its own terms. So the wager was made and also quietly insured — which is itself the archive’s posture in miniature: bet on fragility, and preserve anyway.
